Private Declare PtrSafe Function OpenClipboard Lib "user32" (ByVal hwnd As LongPtr) As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Function EmptyClipboard Lib "user32" () As Long
Private Declare PtrSafe Function CloseClipboard Lib "user32" () As Long

Private Sub Emptied()
    If OpenClipboard(0) <> 0 Then
        EmptyClipboard
        CloseClipboard
    End If
End Sub

Private Function Listed(v As Variant) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    On Error GoTo Bad
    s = TypeName(v)
    If IsArray(v) Then
        s = s & " " & LBound(v) & " " & UBound(v) & ":"
        For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
            s = s & " " & TypeName(v(i)) & " " & v(i)
        Next
    Else
        s = s & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
    Listed = s
    Exit Function
Bad:
    Listed = s & " E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Typed() As String
    Dim v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Bad
    v = Application.ClipboardFormats
    Typed = Listed(v)
    Exit Function
Bad:
    Typed = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Late() As String
    Dim o As Object, v As Variant
    On Error GoTo Bad
    Set o = Application
    v = o.ClipboardFormats
    Late = Listed(v)
    Exit Function
Bad:
    Late = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function First() As String
    On Error GoTo Bad
    First = CStr(Application.ClipboardFormats(1))
    Exit Function
Bad:
    First = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Sub Act(ByVal which As Long, ws As Worksheet, r As Variant)
    Dim c As Object, w2 As Object
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = 1
    Case 1
        ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 2
        ws.Range("B1").Copy
    Case 3
        ws.Range("A2").Copy
    Case 4
        ws.Range("Z99").Copy
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1:B2").Copy
    Case 6
        ws.Range("A:A").Copy
    Case 7
        ws.Range("A1:A2,C1:C2").Copy
    Case 8
        ws.Range("A1").Cut
    Case 9
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: Application.CutCopyMode = False
    Case 10
        ws.Range("A1").Cut: Application.CutCopyMode = False
    Case 11
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Range("C5").Value = 1
    Case 12
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Paste ws.Range("D1")
    Case 13
        ws.Range("A1").Cut: ws.Paste ws.Range("D1")
    Case 14
        ws.Range("A1").Cut ws.Range("F1")
    Case 15
        ws.Range("A1").Copy ws.Range("F1")
    Case 16
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture
    Case 17
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap
    Case 18
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlPrinter, xlPicture
    Case 19
        ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 50, 50).Copy
    Case 20
        ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 50, 50).CopyPicture
    Case 21
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Copy
    Case 22
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.ChartArea.Copy
    Case 23
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.CopyPicture
    Case 24
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: Set w2 = Workbooks.Add: w2.Close False
    Case 25
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Range("A1").ClearContents
    Case 26
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Rows(1).Insert
    Case 27
        ws.Copy: ActiveWorkbook.Close False
    Case 28
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Range("B1").Copy
    Case 29
        ws.Range("B2").Cut: ws.Range("B2").Copy
    Case 30
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Copy: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 31
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Copy
    Case 32
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 33
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture
    Case 34
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.ChartArea.Copy: Application.CutCopyMode = False
    Case 35
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Copy: Application.CutCopyMode = False
    Case 36
        ws.Range("A1:C2").Copy: ws.Range("A5").PasteSpecial xlPasteValues
    Case 37
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Range("A1").Value = 9
    Case 38
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Calculate
    Case 39
        ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Range("D4").Select
    Case 40
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap
    Case 41
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.ChartArea.Copy: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 42
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 43
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 44
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.ChartArea.Copy: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 45
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.ChartArea.Copy: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 46
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 47
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap: ws.Range("B1").Copy
    Case 48
        Set c = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 100, 200, 120): c.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B2"): c.Chart.ChartArea.Copy: ws.Range("A1").Cut
    Case 49
        ws.Shapes.AddShape(1, 10, 10, 50, 50).CopyPicture: ws.Range("A1").Copy
    Case 50
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap: ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Paste ws.Range("E5"): r = ws.Range("E5").Value
    Case 51
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap: ws.Range("A1").Copy: Application.CutCopyMode = False
    Case 52
        ws.Range("A1").CopyPicture xlScreen, xlBitmap: ws.Range("A1").Copy: ws.Range("B1").Copy
    End Select
End Sub

Public Function Probe(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, r As Variant, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Emptied
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 5
    ws.Range("B1").Value = "text"
    ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2"
    ws.Range("B2").Value = 7
    ws.Range("C1:C2").Value = 3
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Act which, ws, r
    s = "ok"
Answered:
    On Error GoTo 0
    s = s & "|" & Application.CutCopyMode & "|" & Typed() & "|" & Late() & "|" & First()
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    wb.Close False
    Emptied
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Answered
End Function
